# Metadata access

The second data release is assembled from `ehi-core`, the EHI system of record.
The collector uses the same authenticated API as the core editor, follows the
links between fieldwork and bioinformatic records, and writes stable tab-separated
tables for the remaining chapters. No Airtable token or table ID is required.

## Authenticate and collect the release

For an interactive run, set `EHI_CORE_EMAIL`; R will ask for the password using
a non-echoing prompt. For a non-interactive render, set `EHI_CORE_EMAIL` and
`EHI_CORE_PASSWORD`, or provide a current Firebase ID token in `EHI_CORE_TOKEN`.
Credentials and tokens must not be committed to this repository.
When both are configured, email/password sign-in takes precedence so a stale
short-lived token does not prevent collection.

```{r collect_metadata, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=TRUE}
source("R/ehi_core.R")

release <- "EHR02"
release_metadata <- collect_ehi_core_release(release)
metadata_audit <- audit_ehi_core_release(release_metadata)
release_ready <- !any(metadata_audit$severity == "error")

# Generate the current snapshot even when the audit contains known gaps. The
# audit and the rendered warning below make its draft status explicit; callers
# preparing a final release can retain the writer's default strict = TRUE.
write_ehi_core_release(release_metadata, directory = "data", strict = FALSE)

# Keep the object names used by the analysis chapters.
datasets <- release_metadata$datasets
rawdata_metadata <- release_metadata$rawdata_metadata
sample_metadata <- release_metadata$sample_metadata
capture_metadata <- release_metadata$capture_metadata
specimen_metadata <- release_metadata$specimen_metadata
sampling_metadata <- release_metadata$sampling_metadata
host_metadata <- release_metadata$host_metadata
assembly_metadata <- release_metadata$assembly_metadata
genome_metadata <- release_metadata$genome_metadata

release_metadata
```

```{r release_status, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
if (!release_ready) {
  affected <- max(metadata_audit$affected[metadata_audit$severity == "error"])
  cat(
    "> **Draft metadata snapshot.** The live audit found blocking metadata gaps for ",
    affected,
    " hologenomes. The generated TSVs and summaries contain the live collection, with ",
    "unavailable values left blank; they should be treated as draft outputs.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

The API is paginated, and the collector applies release/link filters in
`ehi-core` before downloading large tables such as MAGs. Re-running this chunk
therefore creates a new, internally linked snapshot of the release rather than
mixing records fetched at different times from Airtable views.

## Metadata completeness audit

The audit distinguishes blocking omissions from non-blocking warnings and
known schema differences. It is also written to
`data/EHR02_metadata_audit.tsv` with the release tables.

```{r metadata_audit, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
metadata_audit %>% tt()
```

The `ehi-core` schema contains the release membership and linked fields required by
the statistics and visualisations in this book. Total, host and metagenomic gigabases
are derived from preprocessing base counts; sample, capture, specimen and
sampling-event relationships are derived from core links.

Three columns from the historical Airtable sample export are not represented
in `ehi-core`: sample origin, freshness, and time to freezing. They are retained
as `NA` columns to keep the TSV interface stable. None is consumed by the
current statistics or plots, so this does not block the second data release,
but it does prevent complete metadata parity with the former sample table.

## Output tables

```{r metadata_table_counts, warning=FALSE, comments="", message=FALSE}
tibble::tibble(
  table = c("rawdata", "sample", "capture", "specimen", "sampling", "host", "assembly", "genome"),
  rows = c(
    nrow(rawdata_metadata), nrow(sample_metadata), nrow(capture_metadata),
    nrow(specimen_metadata), nrow(sampling_metadata), nrow(host_metadata),
    nrow(assembly_metadata), nrow(genome_metadata)
  )
) %>% tt()
```
